### Both Sides: Foreign buyers and rural land
Argentina's Chamber of Deputies has been asked to decide whether article 154 of decree 70/23 stays in force. That article repealed the Rural Lands Law and removed the limits the law had set on foreigners acquiring rural land.

Elisa Carrió, founder of the Civic Coalition, asked the Chamber on Wednesday to reject the article. Her reason is the repeal itself: the decree left those statutory limits without effect, and she wants deputies to restore them.
